en: Opening the context panel now reads the selected Codex session’s native usage record. Manual refresh reports missing records instead of silently succeeding. Accounts without a session and settings awaiting the next run show their actual state; measurements from an old session are not substituted.

Codex usage notifications retain their native thread ID even when they arrive before thread/start or thread/resume returns. Resumed sessions recover recorded context usage when no fresh notification is emitted.

Verified with a real, isolated Codex session: the desktop compaction button called the native compact endpoint, waited for completion, displayed the returned token usage, and refreshed to the same recorded result. Existing user tasks were not compacted. Unreported auto-compaction thresholds remain unknown.
zh: 打开上下文面板时读取当前 Codex 会话的真实用量记录；手动刷新读取不到记录时明确提示，不再无反馈。尚无会话与设置待生效分别显示实际状态，不拿旧会话用量代替当前数据。
修复原生用量通知早于会话启动或恢复响应时的会话标识绑定；恢复会话未收到新通知时，从该会话记录补齐上下文用量。
已用独立真实 Codex 会话验证：界面压缩按钮调用原生压缩接口，等待完成并显示返回用量，刷新结果与原生记录一致。未压缩用户已有任务；官方未返回的自动压缩阈值仍明确保留未知状态。
